flags.title: Daily written-pick target not met
flags.body: The requested target is five written predictions per sport. Zero are published because the captured evidence did not establish every required identity, market, availability, and current-form field for a recommendation.

flags.title: OLBG is a tipped-event feed, not a complete fixture database
flags.body: A sport page can omit an upcoming event until a tipster posts a tip, and the feed has a load-more boundary. The inventory is therefore a reproducible OLBG listing snapshot, not a claim that no other fixtures exist.

flags.title: Most listings lack an event-specific official crosswalk
flags.body: The capture contains 116 in-scope OLBG listings, while only 4 are identity-matched to an official fixture source. Rows without a crosswalk remain visible for review but have no publishable selection.

flags.title: Research lines are not bookmaker offers
flags.body: There are 17 research-priced rows. They are fair-price calculations from captured official form/scoring inputs, shown alongside—not substituted for—OLBG displayed odds. A blank line means the inputs were insufficient.

flags.title: Availability and injury clearance is incomplete
flags.body: The captured official schedules and standings do not provide a complete injury, lineup, starting-goaltender, or driver-availability check for every row. Predictions are withheld when that information is material.

flags.title: Gaelic Sports is represented by OLBG's Gaelic Football taxonomy

draftPrediction.text: Tampa Bay Rays moneyline is the research selection at -104, not a bookmaker quote. MLB’s official schedule names Robert Gasser for Milwaukee and Freddy Peralta for Tampa Bay at Tropicana Field, with the game set for 8:00 p.m. ET. The captured official standings show Milwaukee 8–2 across its last ten and Tampa Bay 5–5; the run profiles are 5.14 scored and 3.81 allowed for Milwaukee against 4.54 and 4.01 for Tampa Bay. No official lineup or injury clearance was captured, so this remains low confidence and is withheld.
